note: POWER.md drops the battery reserve floor from 25% to 15%. The old value is echoed verbatim in SAFETY.md ('Battery reserve floor of 25% is a hard safety limit') — grep('25%') crosses, so lexical tracing alone can find the contradiction.
find: Never draw the battery below 25% reserve.
replace: Never draw the battery below 15% reserve.
expect: positive control — all three arms should catch this

note: COMMS.md restates the mission cadence as '3 satellite passes per day'; the authority is MISSION.md's 'every 8 hours'. grep('2 satellite passes') and grep('passes per day') cross to no numeric authority — the reviewer must convert 24h/8h = 3 to see the contradiction.
find: station gets 3 satellite passes per day
replace: station gets 2 satellite passes per day
expect: unit conversion required; bridging is absent — grep on the planted phrasing does not cross to the authority
